searchText: For RPC it doesn't matter for us For P2P, there is a <@360491619402776577>'s proposal to drop pre-merge fields from P2P with the new eth/69 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8271#issuecomment-1983279804 and we have a draft PR for it: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/7052 You no longer use total difficulty for the fast sync? so nobody had anything to say against it in ACDE, what would the next steps be? would be good to get some clients to approve on the PR and then last call on next ACDE. if no one speaks against we can merge and consider it removed from the spec <@&652918665943056397> <@&688090867927482525> <@&814631391181930606> <@&1070471163219824730> <@&836981603216654336> PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/570 Since the Merge, the most important information comes from the CL client, so you can't rely on the TD anymore. We use it only to find the best peers (they should have a TD higher than or equal to the merge TTD). I haven't checked our eth/69 PR yet, but it should remove the need for TD entirely if you have a block_hash, you can verify all blocks coming before it, given you trust that hash You need the total difficulty to verify difficulty adjustments during PoW, and Nethermind previously let the user supply it at startup so it could immediately start verifying blocks from head without needing to first calculate difficulty from history. Or something like that. Sounds like not needed since merge though, so I'm happy to see it removed! we're good with removing td as well. need to be cognisant of this possibly breaking some hive sims though if they rely on td for any merge stuff i think in general we should consider removing merge related tests anyways? Ah, I understand what you're referring to now—Sync.PivotTotalDifficulty. While the Pivot* concepts are still not 100% removed from the Nethermind codebase, they are no longer relevant to users, so there is no problem with removing them from the RPC.

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
For RPC it doesn't matter for us
For P2P, there is a <@360491619402776577>'s proposal to drop pre-merge fields from P2P with the new eth/69 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8271#issuecomment-1983279804  and we have a draft PR for it: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/7052

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: You no longer use total difficulty for the fast sync?

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: so nobody had anything to say against  it in ACDE, what would the next steps be?

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: would be good to get some clients to approve on the PR and then last call on next ACDE. if no one speaks against we can merge and consider it removed from the spec

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content: Since the Merge, the most important information comes from the CL client, so you can't rely on the TD anymore. We use it only to find the best peers (they should have a TD higher than or equal to the merge TTD). I haven't checked our eth/69 PR yet, but it should remove the need for TD entirely

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: if you have a block_hash, you can verify all blocks coming before it, given you trust that hash

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: You need the total difficulty to verify difficulty adjustments during PoW, and Nethermind previously let the user supply it at startup so it could immediately start verifying blocks from head without needing to first calculate difficulty from history.  Or something like that.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: Sounds like not needed since merge though, so I'm happy to see it removed!
